## Acumen Pharmaceuticals to Hold Virtual Investor Day on September 16, 2026


September 10, 2026 at 4:00 PM EDT


[PDF Version](https://investors.acumenpharm.com/node/9911/pdf)


NEWTON, Mass., Sept. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ZQd3q0ELZAA8hYZxnDMwPRBwfag0_DR-khxD16q53rSsWgWNyIqJj01obn81EdAaIHHfSt6xXQtuRdm3-yVzi1ILxpVgchB6vmKQXZNkIGc=) (NASDAQ: ABOS), (“Acumen” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics that target toxic soluble amyloid beta oligomers for the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease, announced today that the Company will host a virtual Investor Day on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET.


To participate in the live conference call, please register using this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=a0j10UsrI46IPWF8lOnKUxO_B-eRKpRKYBCyUNtUacmJYt5AiBEvfquq6PThi2z28yNZShUbrA-jESpNZYpgW7DmbsJSK5q1iNAC1G4dkcABA9Ch19cX3R4ToM3nu9VSgXMLt7_VlGzsw4GvTiqnEI8EW0DK1FPLJNCslylLO0E=) . After registration, you will be informed of the dial-in numbers including PIN. Please register at least one day in advance.


The webcast will be available via this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=a0j10UsrI46IPWF8lOnKU_gCuUSzj0KcTvWCTK_17tmr9TXr9ZTjqM-0mY_8uiIj5_s1zKcp747deSs4IYJJ48xc8x0G5tJjSlBSGx0yqLo=) .


An archived version of the webcast will be available for at least one year in the Investors section of the Company's website at[www.acumenpharm.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ldt_kW-PlHdRmbdKbaQGBTUTBglJ_6wS--Bj3xDR9oQPrSnvMuRrc8-povtY8RkNbmtzB4VqmQjzD6fzdeq7k41I-_WHMvsQOlx8hdzS_8E=) .


**About Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc.**


Acumen Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics that target toxic soluble amyloid beta oligomers (AβOs) for the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Acumen’s scientific founders pioneered research on AβOs, which a growing body of evidence indicates are early and persistent triggers of Alzheimer’s disease pathology. Acumen is currently focused on advancing its lead investigational product candidate, sabirnetug (ACU193), a humanized monoclonal antibody that selectively targets toxic soluble AβOs, in its ongoing Phase 2 clinical trial ALTITUDE-AD (NCT06335173) in early symptomatic Alzheimer’s disease patients, following positive results in its Phase 1 trial INTERCEPT-AD. Acumen is also investigating a subcutaneous formulation of sabirnetug using Halozyme’s proprietary ENHANZE® drug delivery technology. Acumen is also collaborating with JCR Pharmaceuticals to develop an Enhanced Brain Delivery™ (EBD®) therapy for Alzheimer’s disease utilizing a transferrin-receptor-targeting blood-brain barrier-penetrating technology. The company is headquartered in Newton, Mass.
